consequence.statement: Setting the removed ConsulCatalog provider `namespace` option is unsupported in v3 and stops Traefik from starting.
consequence.remediation: Use the ConsulCatalog `namespaces` option instead of `namespace`.

assertion.statement: Traefik v3 removes the ConsulCatalog provider `namespace` option, which was deprecated in v2. If it is still set, Traefik won't start, so use `namespaces` instead.
